milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden pickaxe results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must harvest oak logs (6 placed at spawn-relative [-3, 0-2, 0-1]), craft them into planks and sticks using the 2x2 inventory grid, then use the crafting table (at spawn-relative [2, 0, 2]) to combine 3 planks + 2 sticks into a wooden pickaxe. inventory_has is the preferred rule for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because mining andesite with a pickaxe causes the andesite block to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. Andesite (like stone-family blocks) only drops when mined with a pickaxe or better tool — bare hands destroy the block without yielding a drop. The andesite wall is located at spawn-relative [-2 to 2, -1 to 2, 5 to 7]. inventory_has is the preferred rule for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.
